page.layout: One printed page with a title block centred at the top, then three columns of index entries (left, middle, right), each read top to bottom. A large woodcut initial "A" stands at the start of the left column. A signature mark sits at the lower right below the right column.

page.notes: Large woodcut initial A at the start of the left column, joined to "bel"; read as "Abel" by context of the alphabetical entries. Several page-number and sign readings are doubtful and are marked [?] (e.g. 285.a, the "vi-ctoriae" line, "Achab'" and the stain-affected "Achabi clementia"). Line "Achabus cur in prelio" is set with a line-end break in the print; joined here. "pnnitur" and "tepus" are kept as printed. Column numbers are copied as printed, including the "172.a.153.a.136." and "265.b.& 266.a" lines. The handwritten number at the lower right corner of the scan is not printed text and is omitted.
